titulo: Qualcomm layoffs: 520 CA jobs vs $7.8B in buybacks
caption:
Qualcomm layoffs: 520 CA jobs vs $7.8B in buybacks

Qualcomm layoffs: the CEO memo said "We must have the right people in the right roles." Here is the buyback column.

Qualcomm, Oct 20, 2026 (CEO memo, as quoted by Reuters): "We must have the right people in the right roles." Qualcomm's CEO, Cristiano Amon, set out the cuts in an internal memo, Reuters reports. This week the chipmaker filed California layoff notices covering 520 jobs (442 in San Diego, 78 in Santa Clara), the San Diego Union-Tribune reports. The notices cover California only.

A number from Qualcomm's own 10-K: in fiscal 2026 (the year ended Sept. 27, 2026), Qualcomm spent $7.817 billion on stock buybacks, including excise taxes paid, per its Form 10-K. A buyback is when a company spends its own cash to purchase its own shares.
The math: $7.8 billion in buybacks / 520 California jobs = about $15 million in buybacks per California layoff job. The result is approximate.

How many jobs is Qualcomm cutting? The 520 is California notices only. The memo, per Reuters, gives no number of jobs.
Is one paying for the other? We are not saying that. The $7.8 billion is fiscal 2026 buybacks. The 520 is California layoff notices filed in November 2026, which fall in fiscal 2027. Both are 2026 on the calendar, but they are different fiscal years. The ratio is not a cause.

Right people in the right roles. Here is the buyback column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Synthetic voice. Sources: Deccan Chronicle (Reuters), Oct 20, 2026; SEC EDGAR · Qualcomm, Nov 4, 2026; Union-Tribune via The Star, Nov 18, 2026.
